verdict.rationale: jo is a personal agent that works over the user's connected data. Its docs describe AI-generated briefings that draw on GitHub and Linear activity, catch-up summaries of channels, and scheduled weekly plans and morning priorities prepared from what came in overnight. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, explicit documentation of proactive suggestions beyond briefings and priorities, and depth on which data sources feed insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: jo references GitHub activity in briefings
catchup sync — "what did I miss in #engineering?" style summarization
Get a weekly plan, morning priorities, or a weekend task review without asking each time.
read what came in, watch what changed, and prepare your morning before you wake.
jo works with your connected context to help with the messages, schedules, projects, and follow-ups you are carrying.
